---
title: "GB2"
format: 
  html:
    fig-width: 4
    fig-height: 3
---

```{r}
library(dplyr)
library(gamlss)
x <- seq(1, 80, 1)
hzf <- function(fname) {
    dfun <- paste0("d", fname)
    pfun <- paste0("p", fname)
    pdf <- eval(parse(text = dfun))
    cdf <- eval(parse(text = pfun))
    fun <- function(...) {
      lpt <- log(pdf(...))
      lst <- log(1 - cdf(..., lower.tail = TRUE, log = FALSE))
      exp(lpt - lst)
    }
    fun
}

a <- tidyr::crossing(
  mu = 20,
  sigma = 2 + runif(20, -1.5, 10),
  nu = 1 + runif(20, -.9, 20),
  tau = 1 + runif(20, -.9, 20),
)
a
for (i in 7000+1:1000) {
  print(plot(x, hzf("GB2")(x, mu = a$mu[i], sigma = a$sigma[i], nu = a$nu[i], tau = a$tau[i]), type = "l", main = i, xlab = '', ylab = ''))
}
```
